drivers.text: KSE-100 closed up 610 points at 177,382, extending recovery; supportive for equity sentiment.
Rupee gained marginally to 276.51 per dollar in the interbank market, signalling a stable currency.
Short-term inflation reached 10.41% year-on-year, led by wheat flour prices, adding pressure on policy and households.
Foreign investors repatriated $1.16 billion from Pakistan in July-October FY27, weighing on external flows.
SBP's revised financing framework for builders and developers adds new valuation requirements, a mixed credit-sector signal.
